name: Asylum -- UNHCR Mandate Refugee Status Determination (No Domestic Asylum Law)

qualifying_event.description: Mongolia is not a party to the 1951 Refugee Convention or its 1967 Protocol and has no comprehensive domestic asylum legislation. Article 18(4) of Mongolia's 1992 Constitution permits asylum for those 'persecuted for their beliefs, or political or other activities,' but in practice UNHCR -- under a 2007 Memorandum of Understanding with Mongolian ministries -- documents, registers, and determines refugee status eligibility for asylum seekers, pending Mongolia's full accession to the Convention.
qualifying_event.evidence_hint: Registration with UNHCR's operation in Mongolia; evidence supporting a well-founded fear of persecution.

requirement_groups.name: UNHCR mandate RSD under the 2007 MOU

requirements.blocker_text: Well-founded fear of persecution for reasons of race, religion, nationality, political opinion, or membership of a particular social group, per the 1951 Convention definition applied by UNHCR under its own mandate (Mongolia itself is not a party to the Convention).

outcome.duration_length: not specified -- no domestic legal status/permit category is confirmed for recognized refugees under Mongolian law in the sources fetched

sources.title: UNHCR submission to Mongolia's 9th Universal Periodic Review session (OHCHR) -- confirms Mongolia is not a party to the 1951 Convention or 1967 Protocol, has no comprehensive domestic asylum law, and that UNHCR performs registration and refugee-status-eligibility determination under a 2007 MOU with Mongolian ministries pending full accession
